Package index

Load data (as MixSIAR)

load_mix_data()
Load mixture (consumer) data
load_source_data()
Load source data
load_discr_data()
Load discrimination (TDF) data
plot_data()
Isospace plot of the data, as MixSIAR's plot_data()

Fit and summarise

run_pfn()
Fit a MixSIAR model with the prior-data fitted network
output_pfn()
Summaries and plots of a fit, like MixSIAR's output_JAGS()
summary_table()
The summary statistics table of a fit
posterior_draws()
Draws from the marginal posteriors
pfn_networks()
Where the networks are cached, and whether they are there

Compare with MixSIAR

mixsiar_reference()
MixSIAR's own fits of the example data
mixsiar_draws()
Diet proportion draws from a MixSIAR fit
compare_mixsiar()
Compare a fit with MixSIAR's posterior
plot_compare()
Plot a fit against MixSIAR's posterior
